import { createHotContext as __vite__createHotContext } from "/@vite/client";import.meta.hot = __vite__createHotContext("/src/pages/ddl/ddl.vue");import "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-components/style/text.css";import { Text as __syscom_0 } from "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-h5/dist/uni-h5.es.js";import "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-components/style/view.css";import { View as __syscom_1 } from "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-h5/dist/uni-h5.es.js";import "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-components/style/button.css";import { Button as __syscom_2 } from "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-h5/dist/uni-h5.es.js";import "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-components/style/input.css";import { Input as __syscom_3 } from "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-h5/dist/uni-h5.es.js";import "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-h5/style/picker.css";import "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-components/style/resize-sensor.css";import "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-components/style/picker-view.css";import "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-components/style/picker-view-column.css";import { Picker as __syscom_4 } from "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-h5/dist/uni-h5.es.js";import "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-components/style/textarea.css";import "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-components/style/resize-sensor.css";import { Textarea as __syscom_5 } from "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-h5/dist/uni-h5.es.js";
import { api } from "/src/utils/api.js";

const DAY = ["日", "一", "二", "三", "四", "五", "六"];

const _sfc_main = {
  data() {
    return {
      ddls: [],
      suggestions: [],
      filter: "",
      dismissed: {}, // 本地忽略卡片的 ddl_id
      viewSlotIdx: {}, // 每卡显示第几个候选时段
      // 手动/编辑表单
      showForm: false,
      form: { id: null, title: "", course_name: "", d: "", t: "23:59", weight: 2 },
      // 粘贴抽取
      showPaste: false,
      pasteText: "",
      pasteBusy: false,
      parseRows: [],
    };
  },
  computed: {
    // 未完成（逾期也算在墙里，灰档）
    wall() {
      return this.ddls.filter((d) => d.status !== "done");
    },
    wallShown() {
      return this.filter ? this.wall.filter((d) => d.tier === this.filter) : this.wall;
    },
    tierCount() {
      const c = { red: 0, yellow: 0, green: 0 };
      for (const d of this.wall) if (c[d.tier] !== undefined) c[d.tier]++;
      return c;
    },
    parseAll() {
      return this.parseRows.length > 0 && this.parseRows.every((r) => r.checked);
    },
    parseCheckedCount() {
      return this.parseRows.filter((r) => r.checked).length;
    },
  },
  onShow() {
    this.load();
  },
  methods: {
    async load() {
      try {
        this.ddls = await api.get("/api/ddls");
        const s = await api.get("/api/suggestions");
        this.suggestions = s.cards || [];
      } catch (e) {
        uni.showToast({ title: e.message, icon: "none" });
      }
    },
    sugOf(id) {
      return this.suggestions.find((c) => c.ddl_id === id) || null;
    },
    viewSlot(id) {
      const c = this.sugOf(id);
      if (!c) return 0;
      return (this.viewSlotIdx[id] || 0) < c.slots.length ? this.viewSlotIdx[id] || 0 : 0;
    },
    tierLabel(t) {
      return { red: "紧急", yellow: "较紧", green: "从容", overdue: "逾期" }[t] || "";
    },
    dueText(dt) {
      if (!dt) return "";
      const d = new Date(dt.replace(" ", "T").replace("Z", ""));
      return `${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")} 周${DAY[d.getDay()]} ${String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    },
    slotText(s) {
      const d = new Date(s.start_at.replace(" ", "T").replace("Z", ""));
      const d2 = new Date(s.end_at.replace(" ", "T").replace("Z", ""));
      const hh = (x) => `${String(x.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(x.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
      const day = d2.getMonth() === d.getMonth() && d2.getDate() === d.getDate()
        ? "" : `${d2.getMonth() + 1}/${d2.getDate()} `;
      return `${day}${hh(d)}-${hh(d2)}`;
    },
    // ---- 手动/编辑 ----
    openAdd() {
      const now = new Date();
      this.form = {
        id: null, title: "", course_name: "",
        d: `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`,
        t: "23:59", weight: 2,
      };
      this.showForm = true;
    },
    openEdit(d) {
      const t = new Date(d.due_at.replace(" ", "T").replace("Z", ""));
      this.form = {
        id: d.id, title: d.title, course_name: d.course_name,
        d: `${t.getFullYear()}-${String(t.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(t.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`,
        t: `${String(t.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(t.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`,
        weight: d.weight,
      };
      this.showForm = true;
    },
    async saveForm() {
      if (!this.form.title.trim()) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "任务名不能为空", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      const body = {
        title: this.form.title.trim(),
        course_name: (this.form.course_name || "").trim(),
        due_at: `${this.form.d} ${this.form.t}`,
        weight: this.form.weight,
      };
      try {
        if (this.form.id) await api.put(`/api/ddls/${this.form.id}`, body);
        else await api.post("/api/ddls", body);
        this.showForm = false;
        await this.load();
        this.$emit("changed");
      } catch (e) {
        uni.showToast({ title: e.message, icon: "none" });
      }
    },
    // ---- 完成打卡 / 删除 ----
    async toggleDone(d) {
      try {
        if (d.status === "done") await api.post(`/api/ddls/${d.id}/reopen`);
        else await api.post(`/api/ddls/${d.id}/done`);
        await this.load();
      } catch (e) {
        uni.showToast({ title: e.message, icon: "none" });
      }
    },
    del(d) {
      uni.showModal({
        title: "删除 DDL",
        content: `确定删掉「${d.title}」？`,
        success: async (r) => {
          if (!r.confirm) return;
          try {
            await api.del(`/api/ddls/${d.id}`);
            await this.load();
          } catch (e) {
            uni.showToast({ title: e.message, icon: "none" });
          }
        },
      });
    },
    // ---- 建议三键（FR-33：接受/换时间/忽略；绝不自动写日程） ----
    async accept(d) {
      const c = this.sugOf(d.id);
      const s = c.slots[this.viewSlot(d.id)];
      if (!s) return;
      try {
        await api.post("/api/suggestions/accept", {
          ddl_id: d.id, start_at: s.start_at, end_at: s.end_at,
        });
        uni.showToast({ title: `已排到 ${this.slotText(s)}`, icon: "none" });
        await this.load();
      } catch (e) {
        uni.showToast({ title: e.message, icon: "none" });
      }
    },
    async changeSlot(d) {
      const c = this.sugOf(d.id);
      if (!c || c.slots.length < 1) return;
      const cur = this.viewSlot(d.id);
      const next = (cur + 1) % c.slots.length;
      // 「换时间」对当前时段记一次降权反馈，其余时段照常展示
      try {
        await api.post("/api/suggestions/feedback", {
          ddl_id: d.id, action: "change", bucket: c.slots[cur].bucket,
        });
      } catch (e) { /* 反馈失败不打断 */ }
      this.viewSlotIdx[d.id] = next;
    },
    async ignore(d) {
      const c = this.sugOf(d.id);
      const s = c ? c.slots[this.viewSlot(d.id)] : null;
      try {
        await api.post("/api/suggestions/feedback", {
          ddl_id: d.id, action: "ignore", bucket: s ? s.bucket : "",
        });
      } catch (e) { /* ignore 失败也不拦 */ }
      this.dismissed = { ...this.dismissed, [d.id]: true };
    },
    // ---- 粘贴抽取 ----
    openPaste() {
      this.pasteText = "";
      this.parseRows = [];
      this.showPaste = true;
    },
    async parsePaste() {
      if (!this.pasteText.trim()) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "先粘贴点通知文字", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      this.pasteBusy = true;
      try {
        const res = await api.post("/api/ddls/parse", { text: this.pasteText });
        this.parseRows = (res.ddls || []).map((x) => ({
          checked: true,
          title: x.title,
          course_name: x.course_name || "",
          due: x.due_at.replace(" ", "T").replace("Z", ""),
          weight: x.weight,
        }));
        if (!this.parseRows.length) uni.showToast({ title: "没抽到 DDL，检查下有没有带日期", icon: "none" });
      } catch (e) {
        uni.showToast({ title: e.message, icon: "none" });
      } finally {
        this.pasteBusy = false;
      }
    },
    toggleParseAll() {
      const t = !this.parseAll;
      this.parseRows.forEach((r) => (r.checked = t));
    },
    async saveParse() {
      const picked = this.parseRows.filter((r) => r.checked);
      if (!picked.length) {
        uni.showToast({ title: "至少选一个", icon: "none" });
        return;
      }
      this.pasteBusy = true;
      try {
        await api.post("/api/ddls/batch", {
          ddls: picked.map((r) => ({
            title: r.title.trim(),
            course_name: (r.course_name || "").trim(),
            due_at: r.due.replace("T", " "),
            weight: r.weight,
          })),
        });
        uni.showToast({ title: `已加 ${picked.length} 个 DDL`, icon: "success" });
        this.showPaste = false;
        await this.load();
      } catch (e) {
        uni.showToast({ title: e.message, icon: "none" });
      } finally {
        this.pasteBusy = false;
      }
    },
  },
};

import { toDisplayString as _toDisplayString, createTextVNode as _createTextVNode, resolveComponent as _resolveComponent, withCtx as _withCtx, createVNode as _createVNode, normalizeClass as _normalizeClass, openBlock as _openBlock, createBlock as _createBlock, createCommentVNode as _createCommentVNode, renderList as _renderList, Fragment as _Fragment, createElementBlock as _createElementBlock, withModifiers as _withModifiers } from "/node_modules/@dcloudio/uni-h5-vue/dist/vue.runtime.esm.js"

function _sfc_render(_ctx, _cache, $props, $setup, $data, $options) {
  const _component_v_uni_text = __syscom_0
  const _component_v_uni_view = __syscom_1
  const _component_v_uni_button = __syscom_2
  const _component_v_uni_input = __syscom_3
  const _component_v_uni_picker = __syscom_4
  const _component_v_uni_textarea = __syscom_5

  return (_openBlock(), _createBlock(_component_v_uni_view, { class: "page" }, {
    default: _withCtx(() => [
      _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, { class: "stat-bar" }, {
        default: _withCtx(() => [
          _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, {
            class: _normalizeClass(["stat", { on: $data.filter === 'red' }]),
            onClick: _cache[0] || (_cache[0] = $event => ($data.filter = $data.filter === 'red' ? '' : 'red'))
          }, {
            default: _withCtx(() => [
              _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, { class: "num red" }, {
                default: _withCtx(() => [
                  _createTextVNode(_toDisplayString($options.tierCount.red), 1 /* TEXT */)
                ]),
                _: 1 /* STABLE */
              }),
              _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, { class: "lbl" }, {
                default: _withCtx(() => [
                  _createTextVNode("紧急")
                ]),
                _: 1 /* STABLE */
              })
            ]),
            _: 1 /* STABLE */
          }, 8 /* PROPS */, ["class"]),
          _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, {
            class: _normalizeClass(["stat", { on: $data.filter === 'yellow' }]),
            onClick: _cache[1] || (_cache[1] = $event => ($data.filter = $data.filter === 'yellow' ? '' : 'yellow'))
          }, {
            default: _withCtx(() => [
              _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, { class: "num yellow" }, {
                default: _withCtx(() => [
                  _createTextVNode(_toDisplayString($options.tierCount.yellow), 1 /* TEXT */)
                ]),
                _: 1 /* STABLE */
              }),
              _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, { class: "lbl" }, {
                default: _withCtx(() => [
                  _createTextVNode("较紧")
                ]),
                _: 1 /* STABLE */
              })
            ]),
            _: 1 /* STABLE */
          }, 8 /* PROPS */, ["class"]),
          _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, {
            class: _normalizeClass(["stat", { on: $data.filter === 'green' }]),
            onClick: _cache[2] || (_cache[2] = $event => ($data.filter = $data.filter === 'green' ? '' : 'green'))
          }, {
            default: _withCtx(() => [
              _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, { class: "num green" }, {
                default: _withCtx(() => [
                  _createTextVNode(_toDisplayString($options.tierCount.green), 1 /* TEXT */)
                ]),
                _: 1 /* STABLE */
              }),
              _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, { class: "lbl" }, {
                default: _withCtx(() => [
                  _createTextVNode("从容")
                ]),
                _: 1 /* STABLE */
              })
            ]),
            _: 1 /* STABLE */
          }, 8 /* PROPS */, ["class"]),
          _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, {
            class: "add-btn",
            onClick: $options.openAdd
          }, {
            default: _withCtx(() => [
              _createTextVNode("＋ 加 DDL")
            ]),
            _: 1 /* STABLE */
          }, 8 /* PROPS */, ["onClick"])
        ]),
        _: 1 /* STABLE */
      }),
      _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, {
        class: "paste-row",
        onClick: $options.openPaste
      }, {
        default: _withCtx(() => [
          _createTextVNode("📋 粘贴群通知批量抽取 "),
          _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, { class: "arrow" }, {
            default: _withCtx(() => [
              _createTextVNode("›")
            ]),
            _: 1 /* STABLE */
          })
        ]),
        _: 1 /* STABLE */
      }, 8 /* PROPS */, ["onClick"]),
      (!$options.wall.length)
        ? (_openBlock(), _createBlock(_component_v_uni_view, {
            key: 0,
            class: "empty"
          }, {
            default: _withCtx(() => [
              _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, { class: "empty-title" }, {
                default: _withCtx(() => [
                  _createTextVNode("还没有 DDL")
                ]),
                _: 1 /* STABLE */
              }),
              _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, { class: "empty-sub" }, {
                default: _withCtx(() => [
                  _createTextVNode("手动加一个，或粘贴课程群通知自动抽取")
                ]),
                _: 1 /* STABLE */
              })
            ]),
            _: 1 /* STABLE */
          }))
        : (!$options.wallShown.length)
          ? (_openBlock(), _createBlock(_component_v_uni_view, {
              key: 1,
              class: "empty"
            }, {
              default: _withCtx(() => [
                _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, { class: "empty-sub" }, {
                  default: _withCtx(() => [
                    _createTextVNode("这一档没有 DDL")
                  ]),
                  _: 1 /* STABLE */
                })
              ]),
              _: 1 /* STABLE */
            }))
          : _createCommentVNode("v-if", true),
      (_openBlock(true), _createElementBlock(_Fragment, null, _renderList($options.wallShown, (d) => {
        return (_openBlock(), _createBlock(_component_v_uni_view, {
          key: d.id,
          class: _normalizeClass(["card ddl-card", d.tier])
        }, {
          default: _withCtx(() => [
            _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, { class: "ddl-top" }, {
              default: _withCtx(() => [
                _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, {
                  class: _normalizeClass(["badge", d.tier])
                }, {
                  default: _withCtx(() => [
                    _createTextVNode(_toDisplayString($options.tierLabel(d.tier)), 1 /* TEXT */)
                  ]),
                  _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                }, 1032 /* PROPS, DYNAMIC_SLOTS */, ["class"]),
                _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, { class: "ddl-mid" }, {
                  default: _withCtx(() => [
                    _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, { class: "title" }, {
                      default: _withCtx(() => [
                        _createTextVNode(_toDisplayString(d.title), 1 /* TEXT */)
                      ]),
                      _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                    }, 1024 /* DYNAMIC_SLOTS */),
                    (d.course_name)
                      ? (_openBlock(), _createBlock(_component_v_uni_text, {
                          key: 0,
                          class: "sub"

                          default: _withCtx(() => [
                            _createTextVNode("📚 " + _toDisplayString(d.course_name) + " · ", 1 /* TEXT */)
                          ]),
                          _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                        }, 1024 /* DYNAMIC_SLOTS */))
                      : _createCommentVNode("v-if", true),
                    _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, { class: "sub" }, {
                      default: _withCtx(() => [
                        _createTextVNode(_toDisplayString($options.dueText(d.due_at)), 1 /* TEXT */)
                      ]),
                      _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                    }, 1024 /* DYNAMIC_SLOTS */),
                    _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, {
                      class: _normalizeClass(["remain", d.tier])
                    }, {
                      default: _withCtx(() => [
                        _createTextVNode(_toDisplayString(d.remain_text), 1 /* TEXT */)
                      ]),
                      _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                    }, 1032 /* PROPS, DYNAMIC_SLOTS */, ["class"])
                  ]),
                  _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                }, 1024 /* DYNAMIC_SLOTS */),
                _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, { class: "ddl-ops" }, {
                  default: _withCtx(() => [
                    _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, {
                      class: "op",
                      onClick: $event => ($options.toggleDone(d))
                    }, {
                      default: _withCtx(() => [
                        _createTextVNode(_toDisplayString(d.status === "done" ? "↩ 撤销" : "✓ 完成"), 1 /* TEXT */)
                      ]),
                      _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                    }, 1032 /* PROPS, DYNAMIC_SLOTS */, ["onClick"]),
                    _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, {
                      class: "op",
                      onClick: $event => ($options.openEdit(d))
                    }, {
                      default: _withCtx(() => [
                        _createTextVNode("✎")
                      ]),
                      _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                    }, 1032 /* PROPS, DYNAMIC_SLOTS */, ["onClick"]),
                    _createVNode(_component_v_uni_text, {
                      class: "op danger",
                      onClick: $event => ($options.del(d))
                    }, {
                      default: _withCtx(() => [
                        _createTextVNode("🗑")
                      ]),
                      _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                    }, 1032 /* PROPS, DYNAMIC_SLOTS */, ["onClick"])
                  ]),
                  _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                }, 1024 /* DYNAMIC_SLOTS */)
              ]),
              _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
            }, 1024 /* DYNAMIC_SLOTS */),
            (d.status !== 'done' && $options.sugOf(d.id) && !$data.dismissed[d.id])
              ? (_openBlock(), _createBlock(_component_v_uni_view, {
                  key: 0,
                  class: "sug"
                }, {
                  default: _withCtx(() => [
                    _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, { class: "sug-title" }, {
                      default: _withCtx(() => [
                        _createTextVNode("💡 建议投入：" + _toDisplayString($options.sugOf(d.id).slots[$options.viewSlot(d.id)].reason), 1 /* TEXT */)
                      ]),
                      _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                    }, 1024 /* DYNAMIC_SLOTS */),
                    _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, { class: "slot-chips" }, {
                      default: _withCtx(() => [
                        (_openBlock(true), _createElementBlock(_Fragment, null, _renderList($options.sugOf(d.id).slots, (s, i) => {
                          return (_openBlock(), _createBlock(_component_v_uni_view, {
                            key: i,
                            class: _normalizeClass(["slot-chip", { on: i === $options.viewSlot(d.id) }]),
                            onClick: $event => ($data.viewSlotIdx[d.id] = i)
                          }, {
                            default: _withCtx(() => [
                              _createTextVNode(_toDisplayString($options.slotText(s)), 1 /* TEXT */)
                            ]),
                            _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                          }, 1032 /* PROPS, DYNAMIC_SLOTS */, ["class", "onClick"]))
                        }), 128 /* KEYED_FRAGMENT */))
                      ]),
                      _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                    }, 1024 /* DYNAMIC_SLOTS */),
                    _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, { class: "sug-btns" }, {
                      default: _withCtx(() => [
                        _createVNode(_component_v_uni_button, {
                          class: "sug-accept",
                          onClick: $event => ($options.accept(d))
                        }, {
                          default: _withCtx(() => [
                            _createTextVNode("接受这个时段")
                          ]),
                          _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                        }, 1032 /* PROPS, DYNAMIC_SLOTS */, ["onClick"]),
                        _createVNode(_component_v_uni_button, {
                          class: "sug-plain",
                          onClick: $event => ($options.changeSlot(d))
                        }, {
                          default: _withCtx(() => [
                            _createTextVNode("换时间")
                          ]),
                          _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                        }, 1032 /* PROPS, DYNAMIC_SLOTS */, ["onClick"]),
                        _createVNode(_component_v_uni_button, {
                          class: "sug-plain",
                          onClick: $event => ($options.ignore(d))
                        }, {
                          default: _withCtx(() => [
                            _createTextVNode("忽略")
                          ]),
                          _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                        }, 1032 /* PROPS, DYNAMIC_SLOTS */, ["onClick"])
                      ]),
                      _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                    }, 1024 /* DYNAMIC_SLOTS */)
                  ]),
                  _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
                }, 1024 /* DYNAMIC_SLOTS */))
              : _createCommentVNode("v-if", true)
          ]),
          _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
        }, 1032 /* PROPS, DYNAMIC_SLOTS */, ["class"]))
      }), 128 /* KEYED_FRAGMENT */)),
      ($data.showForm)
        ? (_openBlock(), _createBlock(_component_v_uni_view, {
            key: 2,
            class: "sheet-mask",
            onClick: _cache[12] || (_cache[12] = $event => ($data.showForm = false))
          }, {
            default: _withCtx(() => [
              _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, {
                class: "sheet",
                onClick: _cache[11] || (_cache[11] = _withModifiers(() => {}, ["stop"]))
              }, {
                default: _withCtx(() => [
                  _createVNode(_component_v_uni_view, { class: "sheet-title" }, {
                    default: _withCtx(() => [
                      _createTextVNode(_toDisplayString($data.form.id ? "改 DDL" : "加 DDL"), 1 /* TEXT */)
                    ]),
